needsYou.title: Pick the holiday Daily specials (Feesdae)
needsYou.detail: On a special day everyone gets the same themed Daily Hunt: decorations, one twist rule, Oupa's lines, a music sting and a special share card. Halloween is on 31 Oct: if you pick it, the job moves up so it is ready in time. Reply with the numbers ("1–9" takes all my picks).
options: 1. Halloween, 31 Oct: "Spookjag", a dusk hunt with owls, bats, pumpkin lanterns and guineafowl in witch hats
2. Christmas, 25 Dec: Christmas in the sun, tinsel on the camelthorn, Oupa in a Santa hat and shorts
3. New Year: a countdown hunt with party hats, small fireworks and double points in the last 10 s
4. Heritage Day (Braai Day), 24 Sep: the big braai hunt
5. Easter weekend: painted guineafowl eggs hidden for bonus points
6. Valentine's Day, 14 Feb: rosy-faced lovebirds fly through in pairs
7. Spring flowers (late Aug–Sep, one week): the Karoo carpeted in daisies
8. April Fools, 1 Apr: plastic decoy guineafowl, −5 and "Gotcha!"
9. Africa Day, 25 May: drums, every cameo animal out, "Did you know?" facts
10 (maybe). World Wildlife Day, 3 Mar: a camera-only Daily
11 (maybe). Women's Day, 9 Aug: Ouma's hunt (needs an Ouma voice)
12 (maybe). Workers' Day, 1 May: Oupa's day off, Brakkie runs the show
13 (maybe). Namibian Independence Day, 21 Mar: Namibië open to everyone, kept light
needsYou.blocks: The Feesdae job (Halloween needs it by 31 Oct)

v1.7.summary: Meerkat families live on every Kalahari and Namibië map: they peek, keep a sentinel, dig, dash between burrows and dive when you shoot nearby. Shooting one costs −10 (it is never hurt). Secret: hold fire while the whole family is out and they line up for a Familiefoto (+25).
v1.7.requestedBy: You, 24 Oct: "small meerkat holes … peek out and run from one nest to the other. Be creative."

v1.7c.summary: Fruit you shoot reacts: the sausage tree's sausages, baobab and camelthorn pods and marula swing on their stalks or drop to the ground.
v1.7c.requestedBy: You, 25 Oct ~16:45: "when shooting these fruits, make them swing or drop down."

v1.7d.summary: Namibië first: much more detailed bushman grass and sand (no black lines between the distances), then a pair of ostriches at their nest (they run from nearby shots), a herd of oryx far away shimmering in the mirage, and hot-air balloons drifting by (not targets).
v1.7d.requestedBy: You, 25 Oct ~19:50: ostriches with a nest, oryx in the mirage, hot-air balloons; and "the grass landscapes in the Namibia one also look very rough still".

v1.7b.summary: A Power-ups section in the Gun Shed with a picture and a plain explanation of every power-up and crate gun (what it does, how long, how you get it, a tip). In the hunt: crates show what is inside, a short card on pickup says what it does, the chip counts down and blinks before it ends, and each power-up has a small visible effect. Plus a Settings switch: Oupa's comments On / Text only / Off.
v1.7b.requestedBy: You, 25 Oct ~20:20: "one is very unsure what they actually do" and "the option to have the grandfather mode enabled or not".

v1.7e.summary: First, mock-ups of three ways to replace the star glint on secrets: (A) a small unique animal that always lives at each secret (e.g. a rock agama nodding on the dassie koppie, a lilac-breasted roller on the windmill) — Claude's pick and your idea; (B) natural cues only; (C) no cue, Oupa hints in words. You choose. Meanwhile: realistic Bushveld granite boulders and koppies, real ridges in the haze, textured winter veld, no black lines between the distances.
v1.7e.requestedBy: You, 25 Oct ~20:20: "the rocks and the middle distances look childish" and "that star thing is not working for me".

v1.8b.summary: Chacma baboon troops on the ridges of most maps. Now and then raiders come down to cause trouble (steal Oupa's hat, raid fruit, throw fruit at the flock). A raider takes 2 hits and goes down like a guineafowl (your choice). Mothers with babies stay out of range and are never targets.
v1.8b.requestedBy: You, 25 Oct ~20:20: "the African baboon should also be present … pop up and do something naughty that might get them to eat a bullet or two".

v1.8c.summary: A new mode on the title screen. The fence breaks, guineafowl, warthogs and baboons pour into the harvest field, and you have 30 seconds to hold them off while the farm workers fix the fence. A crop meter shows what you saved; the workers are never targets. Tank writes a short plan first.
v1.8c.requestedBy: You, 25 Oct ~20:20: "we could call it the harvest … you've got 30 seconds to shoot as many animals as possible while the fence gets repaired".

v1.6b.summary: Two new crate power-ups. Blitslaai: for 12 s every reload is much faster, with lightning glints on the belt. Oupa Laai: for 12 s an empty gun reloads by itself and Oupa says so. Merged 25 Oct 20:42 after all 23 test jobs passed.
v1.6b.requestedBy: You, 25 Oct 08:40: "Another power-up … an AUTO reload, and a fast reload."
